definition-dropped.answer: character position: §2002:4 (4.31) 'a single character -- either an alphanumeric character or a national character' (storage); 2023 splits it into storage (3.29) and location (3.30). GR5's 'relative character position within the area referenced by identifier-1' counts the same positions in an alphanumeric or national sender. character / coded character set: 2002 senses 4.26 to 4.29 and 4.40, undefined in 2023 clause 3, used in their ordinary sense. The scope is unchanged.
